en: Black‑and‑white view of an old European town with a large, ivy‑covered mansion or small palace on the right, built in a traditional style with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows. Below it runs a stone town wall with an arched gate and adjacent outbuildings. A narrow lane curves alongside the wall, lined with half‑timbered houses and small tiled roofs, with trees and foliage in the foreground. The image has the aesthetic of an early 20th‑century postcard photograph. No visible caption or printed text can be seen on the image side.
